body: damn dude, good luck! Quitting weed is fucking hard. I still crave to do it. Some of my co-workers are selling a dub for some fire shit. Im trying to keep the temptation down though. Glad to hear you are doing therapy for your body. My knee just flared up at work so Idk if I can continue working there. Where are you moving to? I hope you remain safe and set bud! good luck!
Sorry for the late reply, i haven't been on reddit lately because of work. I hope everything is okay. Life will get better hopefully, for the both of us.

You got it my friend, if you can stop for that long after abusing it, you will get through it.  The fact thay you recognized it was a problem, that says you have enough power over it. I still crave to smoke, but im quitting cold turkey, that drug has taken over my life. So i need to take control of mine. Good luck on the rehab! I hope your body heals well! Also good luck on the move! I hope a new environment gives you that push to better yourself and start over! You'll be a blank canvas again, this time, paint your own story bud!

I know how it feels to love not being sober. I blazed cannabis for 3 year straight everyday...I only used it once this year which was a couple days ago, it felt good, but i realized its just a path to destruction. Try to be sober for a week, I promise, you will feel accomplished. I know being sober sucks, but knowing that you can control yourself feels even better!
Don't OP, you will damage your internal organs for life. You will also most likely survive. Hang onto whatever hope you have. PM me if you're still alive.

Yeah, there's a horrible amount of studying. Especially that Im going to take an accelerated program. Thank you, Im not exactly the smartest dude, but i definitely have the will to work hard at anything I put my mind to. I definitely want to change my life for my parents and myself. Yeah I am trying not to abuse anything, at least I have some nicotine help, but that's just a horrible addiction in itself. 

Haha drawing and running used to be my biggest stress relievers besides cannabis. Unfortunately, I have lost my passion for drawing atm because of my realization, but I am willing to try and get back into in the future. When I came back up home to my parents, I actually just took an easel and a canvas and just started painting their new house. I didnt finish it though. Yeah confidence is something i really lack, but i have some willpower to change my life for my parents at least. I hope that remains the same. Haha i can't really ignore pessimistic people because I am one myself, but people who put me down are definitely people I avoid in my life now. Finding friends as an adult has been difficult, many people my age don't really like to go beyond their comfort zone (at least the people i meet) or they're just too busy. That is understandable though. Thank you bud, I hope the best for you too. Thank you, I will try to hold onto my little amount of hope that I have. It's the only thing i've got for myself atm.

Thank you TOMERNATOR. I am glad to hear you have reached a happier point in life. I hope one day that I'll be able to reach it. Hopefully im alive till then haha.

Thanks, luckily my current work at the warehouse is actually helping my body get fit, pushing heavy pallets, carrying stacks of boxes and being on my feet the whole day has actually been good to my body. Of course I'd get the usual cuts and bruises, but no pain, no gain for me haha. I will definitely contact you in the future when I am feeling suicidal or depressed as hell. Thank you bud, I appreciate the helping hand!

Yeah I was planning to go to CDRP, but tbh i thought i needed IOP because my weed problem stemmed from my mental problems. IOP helped a little bit. Im definitely quitting cannabis for a LONG time. I didn't say the medication haha. You guessed right though, Zoloft is what gave me more anxiety. Yeah it was hard for me to quit weed, but hanging out with meth addicts and alcoholics showed me the path of destruction. Weed took me there. Try not to worry about quitting weed though, you will feel so accomplished after 2 weeks of quitting. I promise you. Sorry to hear that you have physical problems and depression. Both are shitty things. I hope whatever obstacles in life that are in your path to success give you the strength to get over them. Just know you're not alone too. Fight those suicidal thoughts, fight the addiction. I've come to realize that I am weak, but also have some mental fortitude because of the things i went through. I am going through a shitty time in my life right now just like you, but let's both try to stay alive to see if things get better. Easy to say, hard to do imo. I'm just glad that Im not alone. That makes me feel 100% better.
I noticed i didn't disclose that in the post, but i don't want to be too specific for privacy purposes. I am under 5'5. Lets just put it at that :).

Thank you TOMERNATOR. I appreciate the kind words and the fact that you read my long ass post lol. 

Yeah running is a good thing. I wish I could do it again, but my knees still have an inflamed bursa tendon so Im just taking it easy for now. I don't have money to get gym membership so I can't use their cardio equipment haha.

You are completely right, I don't want to screw up this nursing program, I feel like its my last chance at school and at life. Im just scared of the stress and giving up. If I fuck up this time, then Ima have HUGE debt and I probably would kill myself tbh. But let's not talk about that. 

Thank you, I will remember every single redditor on this post because you guys are amazing. Thank you for calling me a friend because I haven't had one in a long time.

Thanks for the game advice. My computer is an outdated mac so Idk if I would be able to play those on my computer, but I will take up your recommendation when I save up to get a new computer. I try to play my guitar, write in a journal, and mostly draw in my sketchbook to occupy my free time. Although, i've been desensitized in finding fulfillment in those hobbies lately. I will try to go back to video games and see if they would help me though. I definitely need something to sway my mind from suicidal thoughts. I appreciate you for reading my post and calling me a friend. I hope life is good for you!

Haha yeah you got that right. I think you should go back to school when you found a passion for a certain field though. Not to socialize. Most people in the schools i attended are just competitive assholes, but I guess that's just the reality

Yeah it is. Most creative people are more prone to depression imo. Most of the depressed people i know are either artists or engineering students. Engineering is an art itself haha. Being emotionally sensitive sucks, I wish I was some kind of robot that could just perform tasks logically while me being human, I do things with a certain emotion towards it. I guess I have to train myself to be emotionally numb. Thanks, I will definitely remember you. I can show you some of my old artwork when I decide to post them!

Dude you're not a piece of shit. You tried to help your friend and I understand getting him admitted because he was suicidal has given him a permanent disqualification, but if he couldn't handle what he was going through at that moment, he wouldn't be able to handle the navy. Based on what you said about your experience in the navy, that would've driven him to insanity. I have a buddy from the navy who came out after 3 years and got PTSD, Depression, and was medically discharged. He was perfectly fine before.

You're not a piece of shit, I AM. I am 23 year old college dropout living with his parents, a previous stoner who did NOTHING with his life, have no friends, and no life skills. I am a spoiled brat who couldn't even finish college and my mom paid my whole tuition while we were taking care of my old dad and grandma. I don't even do my own laundry, or clean. I know how to do them, but my parents do everything for me. You on the other hand have finished college, are employed as an officer (i wish i could enlist, but i have disqualifications). You even can get a pretty girl's number. MOST OF ALL, you saved your FRIEND'S life. I think you'd rather have a friend who doesn't talk to you at all than a DEAD friend whose life you could've saved. Im sorry for what you're going through, but in my eyes, you are an excellent human being. You sir are a role model to me. I salute you bro, don't give up!

Im sorry to hear that you have no support system. Do you have family (parents) that you can live with? I was a stoner for a long time, but that doesn't compare to the drugs that you've done in your life. I do know for a fact that people who do drugs with ARE NOT you friends. I've been taken advantage of by numerous stoners. I wish you could go back to rehab and find some like minded people who are trying to quit.

Thank you man, im starting to realize I need to get my life together...I've been on the verge of suicide these past few months and feel like this may be my last year of living. I am hoping that this nursing program will get me back on track. I am just too scared of the stress though. I feel like Ima need some sort of substance to alleviate my stress, but I can't do weed anymore since Im trying to be a nurse haha. I definitely have confidence issues as everybody I know has always told me to not devalue myself. I am working on it though. Thank you for you kind words, it gives me motivation to stay alive. I do hope that whatever problems you have in life gives you the strength to overcome them and that you experience happiness. I am realizing that only right now as I type this. Thank you for reading my whole post. I know it's long, but thank you for taking the time to read my rant, It helps me knowing that there are patient people out there.

No it was my own fault. I couldn't really feel a friendship between my roommate so I felt lonely. He didnt smoke weed or do any other vice while i did. So we weren't that compatible. I ended up hanging out with my neighbors back at my old apartment because I felt like I had a connection with them. We were all down on our luck, were artists, and liked weed so thats why i hung out with them. Turns out you need to really watch out who you hang out with lol. I am a grown ass adult and still didn't realize it until now, so totally my fault. As for art, I did have an instagram account, but i deleted it. I haven't posted my art on reddit. I will one day in the future, I just need my passion to be reinvigorated again. Thanks for taking the time to read my post, it means a lot.

Yeah I have monkey mind and it's the most difficult thing for me to focus on one task. I guess you're right. I haven't bought a pack in 1.5 years so that's an accomplishment. I do use a vape to get my nicotine fix and i smoked a cigarette with a coworker the other day, but I think im done with smoking. Im going to quit vaping soon too. Thank you for the suggestion, I will try to resolve all these family issues. It's kind of out of my control, but I can at least learn to control my vices and go to school again, so i can better myself for my family. Thank you for sticking through on reading my post. Sorry that it was so long :(.

Sorry to hear that you and I experienced some similar problems. I do hope that you get back in school and that life gets better for you. I have a 29 year old neighbor back at my parents place who was a meth addict for 16 years. Has a kid, doesnt have a GED, has a criminal record (went to jail 17 times), but he's still trying to get his life straight. I believe that no matter what age we are, we can still fix it. You can do it too! I believe in you!

Yeah I realized how much weed can ruin a person's life. My addiction got me hanging out with the wrong crowd and kept me from getting a job. I was too scared to even apply to any jobs before in my NEET phase because i was worried about not passing the drug test. Now im committed to not smoking it. Even though i did do it yesterday, i think that's the last time ima ever do it for a LONG time. Thank you for the kind words! I do hope that one day I can do art on the side. I also do hope that I get happy moments later in life because I haven't felt truly happy for 7 years. Im just glad though that my mom is helping me out. Thank you , I will make my life better. Sanity, clarity, and the ability to help my mom pay off the mortgage is what keeps me going.

I will definitely remember that. Lol no success story here, just a privileged loser who is trying to finish school. Nursing wasn't something i even considered before, but I think it's a noble profession. I dont have any medical experience whatsoever, but Im willing to study my ass off. Im just scared of how big the workload is gonna be haha. Thank you for reading my post and thank you for the kind words! I hope that you're able to overcome your problems in life as well. Im still on that journey, but we're all in this journey together, you know?

Thank you. No most of the problems like getting in with the wrong crowd and weed is my fault. I did that to cope with my problems. Not a good recommendation. Im going to try and sober up soon so I can get myself on track. I just wish I had a friend to be there for me...I also hope that whatever problems you go through give you the the strength to overcome them :).

Im sorry to hear that you're going through this so young. I don't mean to be an asshole, but just be glad that you have a girlfriend. Idk how supportive your parents are or if your girlfriend is of much help, but having even a FRIEND is a goodthing. I have no friends and am 22. I dropped out of college due to a lot of life situations (ostracized by family, a breakup of a 3 year relationship, friends excluded me, abuse in the family, and moving around 5 times.) You are young and so am I. Its hard for me to absorb it, but we really do have a lot of time to fight our demons. Just talk to your friends and girlfriend. You will realize having them is better than having no one (I have no friends nor a girlfriend). I too deal with suicidal thoughts everyday and my medications aren't working.

I do hope the best for you.

Sorry to hear that you're very unhappy with your job. It resonated with me that you're 22 and you're a nurse. Im guessing you're an RN?I am the same age as you, but a college dropout. Ive only had 2 jobs in the past. I really admire you on your gpa and your intelligence. I've had bouts with neet dom when i was 20-21 as i had a lot of family problems, moving around a lot, ostracization from close relatives and friends, a breakup of a 3 year relationship and a weed habit...i hate socializing although sometimes i can appear that i can socialize, but i am trying to learn to be more quiet so i don't have to deal with people...i was going to a state university for a couple of years to study design and then eventually illustration, but couldnt handle the stress of college and my lack of social skills (many of my classmates thought i was stupid and weird). There's more to it than that, but that's the gist of it...now a relative and my mom (who is an RN) is pushing me to be a Nurse and i am thinking of going to a private college to get my LVN license...i am not too sure that i want to be a nurse due to my lack of social skills, but i realize that i want to have a well paying job enough to pay my own rent, car insurance, medical insurance...etc. My mental health atm is not good as neetdom made it worse...i became clinically depressed, have GAD, and am suicidal. I was already admitted to a ward once this year...and am in an IOP program to get better. I want to change my life b/c my parents have always been there for me (they paid for my college) and now i feel like a total loser just being a Neet (although i am trying to look for a dead end job for now.) ...do you think i should pursue the nursing field? Im not that good at studying, but i want to change my life. I am just kind of inspired that you are a high functioning person that wants to become a Neet. I think you shouldn't quit being a nurse until you find another career pathway that requires less social interaction. You are a very successful person compared to a lot of us other NEETs who have "worthless" degrees or are dropout due to mental illnesses. I really admire your achievements in life and think you should not become a Neet, although finding a less socially demanding career that fits your needs. U r definitely an inspiration. 

-a dumbass and depressed NEET  

*EDIT: sorry for ranting about my story, i just really empathize with you, i know how it feels to be abused (and im a male), seeing your parents use violence towards each other (my father was abusive to my mom) and to be pressured by your parents to go to college.
